summary: R-6 cab on a 10-foot concrete base, built 1963 after a 1929 cupola cabin; locked and used by Idaho Fish & Game while the Forest Service rehabs it for rental.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on a 10-foot concrete base

access.note: Cab is locked and used by Idaho Fish & Game for goat monitoring and communications equipment; the Forest Service says it is not currently available for rent or reservation.

visit.trail_note: Day hike with trails managed jointly with Idaho Fish & Game; one 2024 hiker estimated about 9 miles round trip. The cab is locked.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, St. Joe National Forest (Idaho Panhandle National Forests); Idaho Fish & Game is a co-user

events.note: Cupola cabin; the site was first developed with this structure
R-6 flat cab on a 10-foot concrete base; the register gives 1963 as the build year
John M. Johnson listed as known staff, citing the Former Forest Fire Lookout Registry
William Lassiter listed for 1960 on both firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts (the latter citing the Kellogg Evening News)
Kjell Peterson listed as known staff on Idaho Fire Lookouts
Locked up in August 2024; Idaho Fish & Game using it for goat monitoring and communications equipment; St. Joe National Forest rehabbing it for a future rental program

corrections.proposed: U.S. Forest Service, St. Joe National Forest (Idaho Panhandle National Forests)
corrections.why: The Forest Service page presents the lookout as its own recreation site, and Idaho Fire Lookouts says the St. Joe National Forest is rehabbing it. Idaho Fish & Game uses the cab but does not appear to own or manage it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1963 as the build year. The firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts pages also credit a 1929 cupola cabin on the site. Treated as an earlier structure (1929) followed by the present R-6 cab (1963).
The register gives 6,749 ft (2,057 m); firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 6,760 ft. The record keeps the register figure, 2057.1 m.

notes_for_editor: Record height_m 3.0 matches the 10-foot concrete base, not the total tower height; no source gives total height, so height_m is omitted. Both pages name William Lassiter for 1960, so there is no conflict; Idaho Fire Lookouts lists Kjell Peterson for 1968, not 1960 (corrected in fact-check 2026-10-08). No notable fires were found in the sources checked, so no fire events are recorded. Access 'restricted' rests on the August 2024 Idaho Fire Lookouts visit and the undated Forest Service page; no 2025-26 check. Elevation in the record (2057.1 m) matches the NHLR figure.
